answer: Joining needs a 500-token bond and public referrals; three sponsors earn a violet badge. A farmer who tries to forge fake referrals is exposed: same sponsors, same timing, no outside links, so peers slash all bonds. To forge 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 500 = 500,000 tokens; one honest agent pays 500 once. Trust reaches its zenith after 20 clean epochs; the bond unlocks. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards; fakes pay 1,000 times, lose all.
